note: Single-pass extraction by Claude reading the paper text; evidence references sections/figures/tables. No multi-run validation.

components.description: Pruning amplifies repetition; entry/persistence analysis motivates FOCUS and RePAIR, which are evaluated

nodes.name: Pruning amplifies repetition
nodes.description: Pruned LLMs show more repetition-loop degeneration than unpruned ones even when perplexity and task accuracy are largely unchanged; with top-p sampling the repetition rate is 5.9% unpruned, 12.4% width pruned and 15.4% depth pruned after Alpaca fine-tuning.

nodes.name: Degeneration is a sharp entry event
nodes.description: Replacing only the first two onset tokens with a top-2 alternative reduces CREP of the unpruned model from 5.9% to 0.7% under sampling and from 26.6% to 10.8% under greedy decoding.

nodes.name: Entry risk vs persistence decomposition
nodes.description: P(Coverage >= tau) <= R_T * rho_bar^l_tau: loop entry risk R_T enters linearly while persistence rho_bar is exponentiated by the required in-loop run length.

nodes.name: Persistence controlled by escape mass
nodes.description: Under nucleus sampling, persistence rho(c) = a(c)/(a(c)+e(c)), so reducing persistence requires increasing escape mass e(c) inside the nucleus, not entropy over the full vocabulary.

nodes.name: Forward-KL distillation mode-averages
nodes.description: Under capacity constraints from pruning, minimizing forward KL gives a single broadened student approximation that moves probability into intermediate and low-density regions of a multimodal teacher.

nodes.name: Tail leakage raises entry risk
nodes.description: Forward KL gives little pressure against student mass on teacher-suppressed tokens; leakage tokens admitted into the nucleus become sampleable and increase entry risk R_T.

nodes.name: Alternative collapse raises persistence
nodes.description: Pruning distorts near-tied teacher alternatives at loop-sensitive contexts into one dominant continuation, reducing escape mass and raising rho and its supremum.

nodes.name: Two supervision targets
nodes.description: Training should suppress leakage toward teacher-suppressed tokens to reduce entry risk and preserve or promote plausible escape alternatives within the nucleus to reduce persistence.

nodes.name: FOCUS objective
nodes.description: FOCUS reweights each token's distillation term by w = (q/beta + 1 - q)^gamma-style confidence weights emphasizing high-confidence teacher regions, equivalent to standard KD with a reweighted teacher distribution (gradient Z(p - q_tilde)).

nodes.name: RePAIR pairs and margin loss
nodes.description: RePAIR builds negative samples from repetitive pruned-model outputs and positive samples regenerated from the unpruned model at the first repetition onset, trained with a token-level margin ranking loss; total loss is L_CE + 0.05 L_FOCUS + 1 L_RePAIR.

nodes.name: Open-ended results
nodes.description: On WikiText-103 with Llama-3.1-8B, RePAIR alone reaches MAUVE 0.68 and CREP 2.23 (KD: 0.61 and 7.3), and FOCUS+RePAIR gives MAUVE 0.73 and CREP 0.57, with only a small perplexity increase.

nodes.name: Instruction-following results
nodes.description: On Self-Instruct with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, RePAIR lowers CREP to 0.63 and raises EAD1 to 0.32 versus KD (1.97, 0.28); FOCUS combined with RePAIR gives the best results on most metrics.

nodes.name: FOCUS improves other objectives
nodes.description: Adding FOCUS to UL, SG, DITTO and RePAIR improves generation quality (higher MAUVE, lower CREP) with only slightly higher perplexity.

nodes.name: FOCUS preserves teacher tail structure
nodes.description: FOCUS keeps tail agreement stable while substantially raising tail correlation and head agreement, and expands the number of viable head candidates from 148.6 to 202.1.

isolated_nodes.name: Prior mitigation degrades perplexity
isolated_nodes.description: Methods that lower probabilities of previously generated tokens reduce repetition but give no guidance on which tokens to generate, resulting in degraded perplexity.

isolated_nodes.name: Experimental setup
isolated_nodes.description: Experiments prune 25% of Llama model width with LLM-Pruner, fine-tune on Alpaca with LoRA for two epochs with self-distillation, and evaluate with top-p 0.9 on 1,000 WikiText-103 and 1,000 Self-Instruct prompts.

isolated_nodes.name: Mean repeated-token probability rises
isolated_nodes.description: The mean probability of repeated tokens shows an increasing and saturating trend, suggesting rising tendency toward persistence.

structural_reasoning: Argument runs from the empirical observation of pruning-induced repetition, through the entry/persistence theory, to two objectives derived from it and their empirical evaluation.
